note: Budgets with ~15% headroom over measured values. Totals sum every chunk compressed separately, so splitting adds per-file gzip overhead; total JS gzip was raised from 60 kB to 70 kB for that reason and for the navigation shell (+~5 kB gzip). Raise only with justification in the PR. Value-first MVP (2026-11-03): total JS raised to 215 kB / 80 kB for the role reading of Mission Control (separate chunk, about 11 kB gzip); initial JS budget unchanged. Catus brand (2026-11-04): CSS raw raised to 20 kB. Comparable builds, same tool: 75a9c14 17,896 bytes; this stylesheet 19,793; the same rules with every var() replaced by its value and without :root tokens or @font-face 18,455. The tokens cost 1,338 bytes (765 of declarations, 573 of var() references), the remaining growth is 559. Headroom is 1%, below the 15% of the other budgets, and CSS gzip is at its limit (5,000 of 5,000); every JS budget unchanged. fontBytes is a new budget for the two self-hosted WOFF2 files, already compressed; the gate checks their signature. Nenhuma demanda esquecida (2026-11-04): no budget raised; terser replaced esbuild as minifier and duplicate screens were removed to fit the action queue.
